steps.evidence: README.md:69-73 (.env.example -> .env.local); env.mjs validates every server var at next.config import

optionalSteps.evidence: prisma/migrations (MySQL); README is silent, needed for sign-in/dashboard but not for the dev server to start

notes: Archived project. pnpm per README and pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfile v6, i.e. pnpm 8); no packageManager field and no CI. next.config.mjs imports env.mjs (@t3-oss/env-nextjs), which requires every server variable to be non-empty, so `pnpm dev` fails until .env.local fills NEXTAUTH_SECRET, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN, SMTP_FROM, POSTMARK_API_TOKEN, POSTMARK_SIGN_IN_TEMPLATE, POSTMARK_ACTIVATION_TEMPLATE, STRIPE_API_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and STRIPE_PRO_MONTHLY_PLAN_ID. DATABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL have defaults. Any non-empty values let it start, but sign-in needs real GitHub OAuth or Postmark credentials. The database is MySQL (PlanetScale per README/.env.example). The README never says how to create it or apply the schema. Prisma client generation happens automatically in postinstall. .nvmrc pins v16.18.0. `pnpm dev` runs contentlayer dev and next dev concurrently.
